ana (ML): Heads-up — during llama3-70b-int4v2 bring-up I hit a flaky regression in the longchain QA harness. failures start happening past the 65536 token mark, near shard boundary.
ana (ML): Symptoms: occasional token re-ordering (suffix appears before prefix) and coherent drift in RoPE phases for tokens around the 65k-65k+N window. Not every run, ~1/8.
samg: hmm, interesting. is this only on int4v2 quantized build or also fp16/bf16?
ana (ML): Only on int4v2 so far. I ran a quick fp16 baseline and it was clean across same prompts.
kyle_r: can you paste the reproducer command? might be related to KV sharding/tiling logic hitting a fencepost.
ana (ML): Repro command:
```
./run_harness --model=llama3-70b-int4v2 --prompt-file=longchain_qa.json --max-tokens=70000 --batch=1 --kv-shards=8 --seed=42 --dump-kv=kv-dump.pkl
```
ana (ML): Attached short log snippet where you can see token indices around the swap: "tok[65534]=... -> tok[65536] shows after tok[65538]".
bench-bot: new run 2026-03-20T14:12Z id=r3781 status=FAIL latency=1.2s/q token error-rate spikes at 65536..65550 region
maria_prod: could be RoPE wrap semantics with our rotary scaling interpolation on quantized kernels. We changed the fallback to linear-phase-interp in int4v2 earlier.
samg: do we have KV key dumps? need to check if keys match expected absolute positions vs shard-relative offsets.
kyle_r: ana, can you share the kv-dump? specifically want the (layer, head) keys around positions 65520-65560.
ana (ML): Uploaded kv-dump.pkl to /artifacts/eng-ml/2755551234/kv-dump.pkl and a minimal diff patch of tokens.
infra-bot: artifact uploaded by ana (ML): https://artifacts.internal/eng-ml/2755551234/kv-dump.pkl
maria_prod: quick check: are we performing any modulo on position indices before rotary application? int4 kernels had an optimization to remap pos%window for cache locality.
ana (ML): yes we added pos % 32768 trick to reduce kernel noise for huge contexts. suspect that modulo with shard joins is causing relative index mismatch when shard start != 0 after rollover.
samg: that matches the re-order symptom — if one shard wraps earlier, its KV indices may be treated as older and stitched at wrong offset, causing tokens to appear earlier in decode.
kyle_r: try forcing no-modulo path: set environment variable NO_POS_REMAPPING=1 and run a couple of quick reproductions. if it disappears then it's definitely our remap logic.
ana (ML): Running now (quick smoke).
(3m later)
ana (ML): smoke run with NO_POS_REMAPPING=1 -> no reorders in 8/8 runs so far. looks promising.
ana (ML): But perf hit is ~6% token throughput reduction. We need a more surgical fix — maybe adjust shard-join offset correction rather than turning remap off globally.
maria_prod: agree. also check interaction with rotary-phase interpolation step. current int4 path uses float16 interpolation weights computed under remap assumption. if index space changes behavior that could produce phase leakage.
samg: action items: 1) kyle to prototype shard-join offset correction that compensates for pos%window remap, 2) ana to run a longer regression 50+ runs with NO_POS_REMAPPING to gather stats, 3) maria to audit the int4 interpolation kernel for assumptions about absolute indices.
kyle_r: I'll add a unit test that constructs two shards with non-zero start offsets and asserts KV keys map to global positions after join.
ana (ML): I'll also gather model-output diffs and loss deltas across fp16 vs int4 to quantify quality regression.
ana (ML): Side note: bench-bot run r3781 also logged a small bump in perplexity in the affected window; attaching eval delta in /artifacts/.../eval-delta.json
bench-bot: eval delta uploaded id=r3781_eval path=https://artifacts.internal/eng-ml/2755551234/eval-delta.json
infra-bot: scheduled ephemeral instance for kyle_r (8xA100) to run debug harness — job id infra-9921
samg: thanks. if we confirm it's remap-shard join bug we'll patch int4 kernel to accept global-position input vs remapped, and add a longcontext test to CI (>=70k tokens).
maria_prod: also add a short fuzz harness to randomly break shard boundaries and validate no token reorder at join. can reuse ana's longchain_qa prompt set.
kyle_r: will open PR with test + fix prototype and ping this thread. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ana (ML): great — I'll keep iterating on repro and post any new failure patterns here. thanks all :thumbsup:
